Pre-existing console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Not introduced by the loyalty feature.

action_items: (Optional, pre-existing) Migrate remaining shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius RN styles and props.pointerEvents to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to silence the two console deprecation warnings. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: loyalty.py: plan() computes `usable = max(0, rewards + (stamps + n)//BLOCK - reserved)` – correctly uses only FINAL state, keeping rewards non-decreasing under completions/cancellations (comment in file).
loyalty.py reserve(): compare-and-set `{_id, reserved: reserved_before}` is the right primitive for the two-simultaneous-orders race; test_loyalty.py already covers it ('exactly one').
loyalty.py finalize(): claim-via-find_one_and_update on `loyalty.finalized:{$ne:true}` makes the stamp/reward move exactly-once, verified by the 'retried finalize' test.
frontend/app/checkout.tsx L289-297: discount row only shown when loyaltyDiscount>0; login hint only when guest AND cart non-empty – matches spec.
frontend/src/components/loyalty-card.tsx: 10 stamp cells, 10th is the reward stamp (-50% label), progress reads from `summary.stamps` / `summary.block` – no client-side computation of rewards (good).
